Animal Rescue and Care (ARC) is a Kolkata based NGO registered under trust act in 2016 that has been working for the welfare of stray animals and their rights. The main objective of this organization is to create a better world for the voiceless friends by spreading awareness among people so that people live in harmony with the less privileged ones and defend their rights. 

ARC has two different shelters, the old one located in Kolkata District and a bigger rehabilitation shelter in Burdwan District.

ARC’ rescues animals those are ill or injured or animals those are subject to torture and abuse. ARC provides them relief, treatment, adequate care and a safe Refuge. ARC also provides shelter to senior and differently abled street dogs.
ARC conducts regular and organized ABC programs, proper Vaccination, De-worming and feeding drives with an aim that one day there will be no animal going to sleep with a hungry tummy or without a roof above his/her head.
